description:
We are seeking a highly skilled individual to expertly handle, process and/or forward client calls and partner enquiries, in German, French, Italian and English, on various topics related to cards payment, in accordance with our work instructions.

This position is part of our evening and weekend team, with working hours primarily outside standard office times.

Key responsibilities:

• Answer incoming calls and handling inquiries from customers and business partners in German, French, Italian or English

• Receive and process client complaints and issues related to credit, prepaid and debit cards

• Ensure timely and satisfactory resolution of client concerns to enhance client satisfaction and loyalty

• Ensure all customer interactions and processes comply with internal quality standards and legal regulations

• Proactively find solutions for client complaints and escalating complex cases to the appropriate department

• Identify sales opportunities (selling and upselling) during interactions with the customers

What do we offer?

• Flexibility in working from home and the management of working hours in order to guarantee a healthy work-life balance

• Numerous benefits and incentives

• Well-being, motivational and team-building activities

For the job opening, we are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

• Commercial or tourism background

• Experience in customer service

• Good knowledge of Office package/ PC use

• Good communication skills

• Languages: Italian, German/Swiss German, French and English

• As the first point of contact with customers, the following soft skills are needed: courtesy, empathy, customer orientation and ability to work in team

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Stiamo cercando un individuo altamente qualificato per gestire, elaborare e/o inoltrare chiamate cliente e richieste di partner, in tedesco, francese, italiano e inglese, su vari argomenti relativi al pagamento delle carte, in conformità con le nostre istruzioni di lavoro. Questa posizione fa parte del nostro team serale e fine settimana, con orari di lavoro principalmente al di fuori degli orari standard dell'ufficio. ## Mansioni
• Rispondere alle chiamate e alle richieste di assistenza da parte di clienti e partner commerciali in tedesco, francese, italiano o inglese
• Ricevire e elaborare reclami e problemi relativi a carte di credito, prepagate e di debito
• Assicurare una risoluzione tempestiva e soddisfacente delle preoccupazioni del cliente per migliorare la soddisfazione e la lealtà del cliente
• Assicurare tutte le interazioni e i processi del cliente conformi agli standard di qualità interna e alle normative legali
• Come primo punto di contatto con i clienti, sono necessarie le seguenti competenze morbide: cortesia, empatia, orientamento del cliente e capacità di lavorare in team

• S'assurer que toutes les interactions et les processus des clients sont conformes aux normes internes de qualité et aux règlements juridiques
• Trouver des solutions proactives pour les plaintes des clients et augmenter les cas complexes au service approprié
• Identifier les opportunités de vente (vente et vente) pendant les interactions avec les clients ## Cosa offriamo
• Flexibilité dans le travail à domicile et la gestion des heures de travail afin de garantir un équilibre sain entre le travail et la vie personnelle
• De nombreux avantages et incitations
• Activités de bien-être, de motivation et de team-building ## Requisiti
• Expérience commerciale ou touristique
• Expérience dans le service à la clientèle
• Bonne connaissance de l'utilisation du bloc bureau / PC
• Bonnes compétences en communication
• Langues: italien, allemand/ suisse allemand, français et anglais
• Comme premier point de contact avec les clients, les compétences suivantes sont nécessaires : courtoisie, empathie, orientation client et capacité de travailler en équipe
